long_biography.plain_text:
Robert Burk’s move into Energy Transfer followed a long relationship between his former firm and the propane business Heritage. Doerner, Saunders, Daniel and Anderson had acted as Heritage’s outside counsel before its public listing. Burk joined the combined energy group as vice president, general counsel and secretary, bringing that advisory background into an internal corporate role.

Away from legal work, Burk has described travel as a shared family interest. His connections span northeastern Oklahoma and Naples, Florida, where a second home encouraged an enthusiasm for saltwater fishing. He has also spoken warmly of Tulsa’s prosperity and its Art Deco architecture, challenging the rural stereotypes that visitors sometimes associate with his home state.
